messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — High error rate for model-infer-prod (model_id: redwood-llm-v2b). Spike in 500s and garbled tokens reported. Pager: https://incidents.redwood/internal/1865004321

Alex (oncall): I'm on it. Looking at canary vs prod traffic. Can everyone avoid pushing or toggling flags? I'll post updates.

Maya SRE: seeing repeated tokenizer mismatch in logs: tokenizer_id in model metadata != active tokenizer on runtime. Example:
```
ERROR tokenization: expected tokenizer 'rwd-tokenizer-v3' but got 'rwd-tokenizer-v2'
weight_hash: abc123def4567890
```

Jit Support: customers reporting garbled transcript for voice-assist beta (3 customers). Severity: P2 -> P1 potential if sustained.

Ashley (prod): Confirmed: search autocomplete latency up and nonsense tokens for ~3% of requests. No data exfil.

Alex (oncall): Can we flip the feature flag that routed a subset to v2b weights? Who owns the rollout? @Kyle Eng

Kyle Eng: That rollout was automated via artifact alias "weights-latest" — looks like alias pointed to wrong weightset. I can flip alias but prefer kill-switch on routing policy now.

Jordan PM: Customers flagged: 'search degraded' and 'weird tokens'. Prepared statement? Hold until rollback.

Maya SRE: Recommending immediate feature flag kill and rollback to weightset abc000fff111 then restart inference pods gracefully.

Alex (oncall): Executing kill-switch for route 'canary-v2b' now. Will also enqueue rollback. @incident-bot please note action: feature-flag kill

incident-bot: Action recorded: kill_flag applied to route 'canary-v2b' by Alex at 1865004500

Kyle Eng: Alias flipped to abc000fff111 and rolling new assignment. Pushing patch to router config: `router.assignments[\"model-infer-prod\"].weights = \"abc000fff111\"`

Maya SRE: Rolling restart in progress. Cache flush on KV nodes to avoid mixed prefix state.

Jit Support: Customer Impact Tracker: 3 affected accounts, emails queued for success team outreach. No billing impact.

Ashley (prod): Metrics: 500 rate down from 3.1% -> 0.2% after kill-switch, latency returning to normal. :thumbsup:

Alex (oncall): Great. Postmortem lead: Kyle. Timeline capture please. Incident declared over for pages but keep thread open for follow-ups.

Kyle Eng: Will log the deployment alias bug and change gating on alias promotions. Drafting postmortem and action items.

Jordan PM: I'll coordinate customer comms with support. Thanks team.

Maya SRE: Follow-ups: revoke auto-promote pipeline step, add validation to verify tokenizer/weights alignment pre-promote, and add a sanity-check in canary to compare tokenizer_id across shards.

Alex (oncall): Closing pager at 1865004941. If anything regresses, re-open. cc: eng, prod, support
